title: Lido begins moving $16.5 billion in staked ether to cut validator count by a third
summary: The liquid staking protocol is consolidating 8 million ETH and requiring its professional node operators to post bonds for the first time.

title: Thailand's SEC alleges Bitkub concealed cyberattack that led to $50 million hack
summary: Bitkub was the victim of a cyberattack in May 2021, which led to hacks stealing 1.7 billion baht across 16 different digital assets.

title: Nvidia forms 37-member AI security alliance without OpenAI, Anthropic or Google
summary: The chipmaker and 36 other companies say defenders need AI they can run themselves. Major AI players OpenAI, Anthropic and Google are not among them.

title: Securitize builds Wall Street credentials with SEC adviser license as tokenization expands
summary: The license broadens the BlackRock tokenization partner's offering as regulators weigh rules for onchain investment products.

title: Crypto is rewriting how Wall Street traders spend their weekends
summary: Around-the-clock crypto markets are forcing Wall Street to reevaluate one of its oldest assumptions: that weekends are for waiting.
